name: S-360-24
description: 360W 24V budget switching power supply from Sompom. Commonly found as the stock power supply in Creality Ender 3 and similar budget 3D printers. Sompom is a Chinese manufacturer specializing in switching power supplies for over 20 years. While functional, the community often recommends upgrading to a MeanWell LRS-350-24 for improved reliability and safety. The Sompom brand also supplies OEM power supplies for various 3D printer manufacturers.
typicalUseCases: OEM supply for various 3D printer manufacturers
